B2-01.ko: 리벳 망치 톡톡 · 작은 몸이 땡 울림
B2-01.atk: a small hand hammer cracks down on a rivet: a quick light tink-tink, a short iron snap as the head flattens, a tiny metallic skitter across the bench
B2-01.def: a thin apron and little plating take the knock: a light dull clank, a small chink of loose rivets falling, a short wobbling ring

B2-02.atk: a youth swings a greasy cogwheel then snaps its teeth shut: a quick clattering whirr, a sharp clack of brass teeth, a squeaky gnash
B2-02.def: no plating at all, it flinches: a soft cloth-and-flesh thud, a startled clatter of dropped cogs, small oily wrenches rolling away

B2-05.ko: 햇빛 냄새 풋내기 · 가시 장갑이 찌름
B2-05.atk: a newcomer shoulder-barges with a leather satchel of tools: a scuffed boot step, a canvas whump, a jangle of pliers and nails against the foe
B2-05.def: a thin studded vest takes the hit with a dull thump, then a quick scratchy sting of bent nails snapping back at the attacker

B2-06.ko: 강철 경비병이 문처럼 밀침 · 철문 같은 울림
B2-06.atk: a steel sentry slams its flat gauntlet forward like a closing gate: a stiff hinge squeal, a heavy iron smack, a flat metallic reverberation
B2-06.def: a plated chest meets the blow: a firm clang, a short deep bong from the hollow chassis, a quick settling of grinding plates

B2-07.ko: 리벳 방패로 밀침 · 방패가 쾅 · 가시가 쏨
B2-07.atk: a guard bashes forward with a riveted shield: a metal strap creak, a broad iron slam, a rattle of rivet heads shivering across the face
B2-07.def: the riveted shield absorbs a hard strike with a deep bong, rivets chattering, then a sharp scrape of spiked rim lashing back

B2-09.ko: 보일러 증기 주먹 · 말랑한 김 빠진 몸통
B2-09.atk: a boiler-powered fist winds up with a rising hiss, then a piston-driven iron punch thuds home with a puff of escaping steam and a creaking wheeze
B2-09.def: no real guard, its tin belly dents: a hollow boiler boom, a sputtering leak of steam, a weary sighing hiss as pressure bleeds away

B2-12.ko: 모루 망치질 · 굳은살 몸이 퉁 울림
B2-12.atk: a smith's mallet swings in steady rhythm: a wooden handle creak, a solid hammer strike on glowing iron, a bright anvil ring with sparks hissing
B2-12.def: a stout leather apron and broad frame take the hit: a heavy muffled thump, a deep low anvil hum, a grunt of chains shifting on a belt

B2-15.ko: 관통하는 대장간 쇠뭉치 · 웅웅 울리는 쇳몸
B2-15.atk: a smith drives a long forged spike through the foe: a sizzling quench hiss, a piercing metallic punch, then a humming ring-out lingering in the steel
B2-15.def: thick forge gloves and heavy smith plating stop the blow: a deep clang, a droning resonance humming through hammer and anvil, hot sparks fizzling

B2-16.ko: 겹장갑 오토마톤 박치기 · 쇠판이 연달아 울림
B2-16.atk: a plated automaton lurches forward: gears grinding, a stiff servo whir, then a hard double-bash of armoured forearms with layered plates rattling
B2-16.def: stacked armour plates take the strike: a heavy clank, a cascade of smaller plate chatters, a brief slipping click of a gear catching

B2-17.ko: 성벽 같은 어깨치기 · 돌벽이 쿵 울림
B2-17.atk: a walking wall of iron lowers its shoulder and shoves: a slow stone-grinding drag, a heavy boom of collision, loose gravel pattering after
B2-17.def: no flexing at all but no true plating either, the slab body shudders: a coarse stony thud, a deep creak of strained masonry, dust sifting down

B2-18.ko: 증기 해머 내려침 · 둔중한 몸으로 버팀
B2-18.atk: a huge hammer hisses as steam pressure builds, rises with a groaning pulley, then a thunderous piston-driven slam and a long iron ring-out
B2-18.def: a thick boilerplate chest blocks: a jarring dull clang, steam hissing from a jolted valve, a low rumbling vibration in the frame

B2-19.ko: 철판 겹겹 골렘 주먹 · 얇은 틈만 뚫리는 소리
B2-19.atk: an iron fist rises with grinding hydraulics, then slams down in a flat deafening crash of stacked plates, bolts shaking and rattling loose
B2-19.def: bare of any real shielding beneath, the plates ripple: a scraping crunch of folded sheet iron, a hollow rattle, a bolt pinging off stone

B2-22.ko: 요새 몸 돌격 · 리벳 덩어리가 무겁게 부딪힘
B2-22.atk: a fortress-bodied brute charges: pounding iron footfalls, rivets crackling like hail across its chest, a massive crushing collision of heavy iron
B2-22.def: its riveted shell takes the hit without armour backing: a massive crunch, rivets popping and pinging, a deep groaning shudder of the bulk

B2-24.ko: 빈 철골이 휘둘림 · 바람 지나는 낮은 울음
B2-24.atk: a skeletal iron frame swings a girder arm: wind whistling through bare struts, a metallic whip-crack, a sharp clang ending in a thin trailing moan
B2-24.def: girders catch the blow: a glancing ring with a hollow tubular hum, wind moaning low through the open frame, a faint rattle of cross-braces

B2-25.ko: 공방 지키는 골렘 · 두껍게 울리는 깊은 방어
B2-25.atk: a dormant golem wakes and slaps down a stone-and-iron palm: dust cracking from its joints, a grinding gear turn, a heavy thud with a deep rumble
B2-25.def: a thick chassis rings deep when struck: a solid dense clang, a long resonant boom echoing inside a hollow chamber, gears settling with a slow click

B2-26.ko: 검붉은 갑주 검 휘두름 · 힘줄 울음 같은 낮은 울림
B2-26.atk: a dark-red armoured soldier sweeps a heavy blade: plate joints clanking, a long steely whoosh, a crashing cut, then a deep sinew-like creaking hum
B2-26.def: blood-iron armour turns the strike: a sharp ring, a muffled throbbing groan in the metal, a gentle chink of chain linking inside the plates

B2-27.ko: 근위장의 육중한 검격 · 방패와 사슬이 막아냄
B2-27.atk: a gate marshal brings down a broadsword in a measured arc: chain mail jingling, a cold blade whistle, a hard slash across a plated shield edge
B2-27.def: a tower shield and mail take the strike: a booming shield clang, chain links rustling, a sturdy thud of a braced heel against stone

B2-28.ko: 집채만 한 강철 주먹 · 거대한 쇠몸 쿵
B2-28.atk: a house-sized steel fist is raised on groaning joints and dropped: a low rumbling swing, a ground-shaking boom, scraping gravel and a long metal drone
B2-28.def: its vast torso rings like a giant bell: a slow resonant gong, a deep rolling rumble, a rain of small rivets pattering on stone

B2-30.ko: 산맥 파수꾼의 바위 팔 · 광맥 같은 단단한 울림
B2-30.atk: a mountain sentry swings a rock-and-ore arm: a rumble of shifting stone, a heavy swoosh, a grinding smash that splinters into a crackle of ore chunks
B2-30.def: exposed ore veins take the blow: a dense stony crack, a deep ringing of buried metal, loose gravel trickling then a long rumble

B2-32.ko: 걸어다니는 성채 짓누름 · 성벽 같은 묵직한 방어
B2-32.atk: a walking citadel stamps: massive gate hinges groan, a floor-shaking footfall, then a crushing slam of a battlement-like arm with stones tumbling
B2-32.def: battlements and gate plating absorb the hit: a colossal clang, a drawn-out castle-like echo, small iron fittings pinging and settling

B2-33.ko: 회색 아다만트 검 · 거인뼈 갑옷이 둔탁히 울림
B2-33.atk: a knight in grey adamant plate swings a bone-pale heavy sword: a dry cold whoosh, a dense low thunk of impact, a stony ring-out like struck marrow
B2-33.def: adamant armour takes the strike: a dull bone-deep clack, a hard muted ring, then a spiky scrape as barbed plates answer the attacker

B2-34.ko: 용광로 심장 거대 골렘 · 하얀 김이 뿜어짐
B2-34.atk: a furnace-hearted giant exhales a rolling white gush of steam, then brings a vast fist down: a roaring crash, a furnace roar, a drawn-out dripping hiss
B2-34.def: its glowing furnace chest rings: a vast booming clang, a venting steam geyser from shocked valves, a slow crackle of cooling metal

B2-35.ko: 대장인의 거대 모루망치 · 장인의 두꺼운 방어
B2-35.atk: a master smith lifts an enormous forge hammer: a chain hoist rattle, a thunderous anvil strike with a pure ringing overtone, a shower of sparks crackling
B2-35.def: a stout beard-braided frame and thick leather-and-iron apron take the hit: a heavy deep thump, a resonant anvil tone, a slow chain-link rustle

B2-36.ko: 요새 골렘 철벽 타격 · 단단히 못박힌 울림
B2-36.atk: a rooted fortress golem swings a slab arm: a slow stone-and-iron crunch, a heavy pounding clang like a drawbridge dropping, dust sifting down
B2-36.def: planted feet grind into rock and its bastion plates hold: a thick solid boom, a long deep metal ring-out, almost no give or movement

B2-41.ko: 폭주 증기 골렘 · 터진 밸브 소리와 충돌
B2-41.atk: a pressure valve whistles as the golem charges: a piercing steam jet, stampeding iron footsteps, a reckless crash with metal fragments and hissing
B2-41.def: tiny fragile frame, no armour: a crumpling crunch of thin sheet metal, a sputtering sizzle of broken piping, a rattle of falling bolts

B2-42.ko: 과열 압착기 눌러 뚫음 · 얇은 철판이 우그러짐
B2-42.atk: a runaway press slams down red hot: a screeching hydraulic whine, a deafening piercing crunch through plate, a hot sizzling hiss of crushed metal
B2-42.def: no real housing, it buckles: a shrill grinding screech, sheet metal folding and popping, steam bursting from a burst pipe

B2-43.ko: 자폭 오토마톤 · 째깍 똑딱 후 폭발
B2-43.atk: a ticking clockwork core races faster as the automaton sprints in, then bursts: a rapid frantic click, a swelling whine, a huge iron-shrapnel boom
B2-43.def: its thin shell shatters at once: a brittle snap of casing, a sprinkling of springs and gears bouncing on stone, a last dying whirr

SP-B2.ko: 철의 심장 박동 · 몸이 커다란 종처럼 울림
SP-B2.atk: a deep iron heartbeat thuds like a forge bellows, then a titan hammer fist crashes down: shuddering steam, a world-shaking boom, a lingering resonant bronze ring
SP-B2.def: a glowing iron heart beats within its chest as the blow lands: a bell-deep clang, a shimmering metallic ward humming outward, steam venting calmly

UN-B2.ko: 브론의 첫 골렘 · 고철 모아 붙는 소리
UN-B2.atk: a patchwork golem of salvage swings a mismatched arm: scrapyard clanks, a heavy iron slam, then a clinking rain of scrap parts snapping together
UN-B2.def: a thick scrap chassis rings deep and dented as extra scraps snap on: a hollow gong, bolts ratcheting tight, plates magnetically slotting into place

UN-B2-7.ko: 사슬로 묶인 두 골렘 · 쇠사슬이 팽팽히 당겨짐
UN-B2-7.atk: two golems swing a taut steel chain: a heavy link rattle, a whipping whoosh, a savage crack of chain against iron followed by clanking links swinging
UN-B2-7.def: a chain links two bodies and stiffens: a loud tense link rattle, a pair of staggered deep clangs ringing in unison, a taut groan of metal

EP-B2-1.ko: 리벳 가시 껴안기 · 가시가 사방으로 박힘
EP-B2-1.atk: a spiked golem lunges into a clumsy crushing embrace: a heavy hug of iron, scraping rivets raking across the foe, a bristling crunch of spikes
EP-B2-1.def: outward rivet spines take the hit: a bright ward shimmer, a dense clang, then a ratcheting prickle of rivets snapping back in a spiny counter-sting

EP-B2-2.ko: 바위 깨는 분쇄 골렘 · 암석 깨짐과 쇠 울림
EP-B2-2.atk: a mining golem hoists a rock-crusher pick: a heavy overhead creak, an armour-piercing crack that splits stone, a long splintering crash with tinkling shards
EP-B2-2.def: a shimmering ward flickers and dense stone-iron plating thuds: a deep dull ring, a ward chime, a grumbling settle of grit

EP-B2-3.ko: 성문 거상 · 문짝이 닫히듯 내려치는 소리
EP-B2-3.atk: a living gate swings its huge door-fist in an arc: a groaning hinge, a vast wooden-and-iron slam, spikes raking, and a boom rolling through the tunnel
EP-B2-3.def: a mighty gate door meets the hit with a gigantic clang and ward shimmer, then spiked studs lash back with a vicious scraping jab

PN-B2-C1.ko: 리벳 박힌 작은 문지기 · 어디든 같은 소리
PN-B2-C1.atk: a little golem pistons its stubby fist: a quick pneumatic puff, a crisp rivet-studded punch, a bright tinkling spray of rivet heads
PN-B2-C1.def: wherever struck it gives the same sound: a firm uniform clank, rivets buzzing in sympathy, a steady unmoving thud

PN-B2-C2.ko: 증기 압연 골렘 · 롤러가 철판을 누름
PN-B2-C2.atk: a walking rolling mill rumbles forward: rollers grinding, a pressurized hiss, a flattening iron crush ending in a squealing release of steam
PN-B2-C2.def: its roller chassis rings under pressure: a thick metallic groan, a low hum of straining gears, a slowly leaking valve hiss

PN-B2-C3.ko: 철골 망치 골렘 · 속이 꽉 찬 쇠 울림
PN-B2-C3.atk: a beam-limbed golem swings a girder hammer: an iron whoosh, a ringing blow with sparks scattering, a gurgle of molten metal inside
PN-B2-C3.def: a solid-cast frame filled with hardened metal takes the blow: a dense unyielding thunk, a faint molten gurgle, a short spiny scrape of counter-spikes

PN-B2-U1.ko: 직접 두드린 방패 · 흠집 많은 방패가 막아냄
PN-B2-U1.atk: a dwarf bashes with the rim of a hand-forged shield: a short leather strap creak, a crisp forward smack, a ring of beaten metal
PN-B2-U1.def: a battered shield takes the hit with a heavy clonk, a long steady ring, and a crisp thorny scrape from the shield rim

PN-B2-U2.ko: 힘줄 광맥 골렘 · 녹지 않는 쇠가 울림
PN-B2-U2.atk: a vein-bodied golem whips a rope of ore-metal arm: a sinewy creak, a taut twang, a heavy iron lash with a sparkling crack
PN-B2-U2.def: a rooted lode body stands fixed: a vast dull ring with no give, an ore-like crackle, and a short spiny rasp in answer

PN-B2-R.ko: 아다만트 갑주 일격 · 회색 금속이 단단히 울림
PN-B2-R.atk: an armoured dwarf swings a grey-metal mace: heavy plate squeaks, a dense low whoosh, a thick stony crack of impact
PN-B2-R.def: grey adamant plate meets the blow with a rock-hard thunk, a shimmering ward chime, a rooted stance grinding into stone

PN-B2-E.ko: 용을 본 거울 골렘 · 되비치는 금속 울림
PN-B2-E.atk: a mirrored golem thrusts a polished fist: a glassy metal shimmer, a punch with a rippling chime-like echo, a long scintillating ring
PN-B2-E.def: its mirror-bright body reflects the blow: a crystalline metallic chime, a shimmer of ward, a deep immovable clang, a sharp spiny glint of counter

UP-B2-12.ko: 단조 명장 · 세 망치가 합쳐진 한 방
UP-B2-12.atk: a master strikes a flawless triple-beat of hammer on anvil: three fast clangs fusing into a single ringing blow, with a white spark sizzle
UP-B2-12.def: a thick leather apron and a forged breastplate take the strike: a deep clean anvil ring, a quiet sizzle of quenching steel, a slow warm hum

UP-B2-17.ko: 성벽대장 · 성벽 부수는 거대한 한 발
UP-B2-17.atk: a bastion captain slams a gate-sized shield forward: a deep stone-grinding push, a vast crushing boom, a rolling echo of crumbling masonry
UP-B2-17.def: a rampart-sized iron back takes the hit: a titan-deep bong, a rolling castle echo, rows of small plates settling in line

UP-B2-18.ko: 세 증기 해머 · 연달아 쾅 쾅 쾅
UP-B2-18.atk: a steam hammer triple rig fires in sequence: a hissing build-up, three thunderous piston slams in a rolling rhythm, a mine-shaking ring-out
UP-B2-18.def: a layered boilerplate hull takes the blow: a heavy ringing gong, three rippling vibrations down the pipes, venting steam drifting off

UP-B2-22.atk: a fortress-bodied lord charges as rivets pop and chain like firecrackers: crunching iron steps, a monstrous collision, a stuttering scatter of rivets across stone
UP-B2-22.def: its fortress shell shudders under the strike: a monstrous clang, rivets popping off in sequence, a thick groan of fortress plating settling

UP-B2-24.ko: 철골 수문장 · 깊은 갱도 철문 같은 일격
UP-B2-24.atk: a deep-mine gatewarden swings a girder like a portcullis: a rattling, screeching chain-and-winch, a whistling slash, a brutal beam-crack booming down the shaft
UP-B2-24.def: its open iron lattice takes the strike: a bright glancing clang, deep ringing along the girders, a long wind-in-the-tunnel moan

MB-02.cast: a rivet gun taps along a seam: a pneumatic puff, bright tight hammer-strikes sealing joints, a steady solid ring as the plating firms up

SB2-01.cast: a line of armoured dwarves surges: chain mail jingling, heavy boots building to a thundering rhythm, shield rims clashing in a rising iron wave

SB2-02.cast: a steam valve whistles, a pneumatic thump launches a glowing rivet: a short hissing flight, a hard clank and sizzle as it pierces plate

SB2-03.cast: a welding torch ignites with a crackling hiss: bright sputtering sparks, a molten seam bubbling shut, a warm settling tick of cooling steel

MB-06.cast: a heated plate wall rises with a grinding slide: a hot whoosh of radiating air, sizzling hiss at the front, a protective low iron hum settling

MB-08.cast: an armoured squad tightens its plates: a clatter of wrenches ratcheting every bolt, plates sliding and clicking, a final deep protective clunk

SB2-06.cast: a vast hydraulic press whines and descends: a creaking groan, a flat devastating crunch, a squealing release of steam and a slow metallic settle

SB2-09.cast: distant furnaces ignite one by one: roaring flames, bellows pumping, anvils chiming in overlapping strikes, a vast deep resonant drone swelling

RB2-1.cast: a siren-like boiler whine climbs, golem cores crack in a chain, then a gigantic rolling blast: collapsing rock, a long grinding rumble, dust and steel pattering

NB2-1.cast: a boiler needle-valve shrieks as pressure climbs: gears spinning up wildly, pipes rattling, a final surging roar of steam venting with force

NB2-2.cast: dwarves lock shields: heavy boots stepping aside, a mighty tower shield thumped against stone, a deep clang with a sturdy rising metallic ward

US-B2-1.cast: golem bodies fall into line with ratcheting clunks, then a giant hammer of fused iron swings: a wind-up groan, a ground-splitting crash, a long ringing boom

US-B2-2.cast: golem footfalls fall in step: a steady iron tread, gears clicking in unison, each added stride heavier with a rolling mountain rumble beneath

PS-B2-1.cast: armoured fists strike breastplates in one firm beat: a deep iron clang, plates locking with a ratchet clunk, a shimmering protective ring held long

PS-B2-2.cast: a glowing blade is dragged from coals and plunged into water: a roaring sizzle, a billowing steam burst, then a clear ringing hardened note as it cools

RS-B2-1.cast: a great warhammer rises with a creak and strikes a plate seam: a splitting crack, armour peeling apart with screeching metal, plates clattering to stone

RS-B2-2.cast: stone-and-iron golems step shoulder to shoulder: a deep unified stomp, interlocking plates grinding, a shimmering ward settling over a vast ringing wall

RS-B2-3.cast: rivet machines flip over and burst: a roaring clatter of countless rivets, pinging off friendly armour, whistling and punching through enemy plate in a metal squall

CS-B2.cast: a steel wedge is driven by a mallet into a humming crack of energy: a rising sparkle cut short by a hard clang, a muffled dead thud, then silence

IB2-1.equip: a rune-etched rivet is pressed on the plating: a light punch of a stamp, one firm tapping of a hammer, a locked metallic click that rings and stays still

IB2-2.equip: a heavy steel plate is lifted and set on: a creak of a hoist, a dull iron clunk, buckles and bolts tightening with a ratcheting snap

IB2-4.equip: a brass core is slotted into a chest cavity: a gear-teeth clack, a steam puff, then a steady soft ticking heartbeat of cogs spinning up

IB2-5.equip: a heavy palm-shaped shield is lifted from a rack: a straps-and-buckles rustle, a dense iron clink on the arm, a muffled knock of a fist testing its face

M3-1.equip: a chisel taps a rune into a stone-iron heart: sharp chip-chip engraving, grains of dust, a glowing low hum rising and fixing with a solid thunk

I4-2.equip: a hulking exoskeleton clamps over a body: hydraulic hiss, heavy latch snaps, ribbed plates sliding together with a low sinewy creak and a deep clunk

IB2-6.equip: a giant glowing core is lowered into a chassis: a deep grinding turn, a pulsing hum building, locking bolts clanking home with a hiss of steam

IR-B2.equip: a thin plate of grey adamant is slid into place: a pure cool metallic whisper, a clean heavy click of latches, a long muted ring when tapped

PI-B2.equip: a thick metal-sinew cable is wound round a body: a taut creaking pull, wire strands twanging, a deep muscle-like hum as it cinches tight with a ringing lock

TK-B2-1.ko: 작은 파수 골렘 · 철판 자그마한 울림
TK-B2-1.atk: a small sentry golem jabs a stubby iron fist: a quick servo chirp, a sharp compact clank, a brief rattle of its loose plating
TK-B2-1.def: its little plated chassis rings thinly: a bright high clang, a tinny shiver of loose rivets, a quick click of resetting joints

TK-U-SCRAP.atk: a jumble of salvaged parts swings a crooked scrap arm: a rattling clang of tin and pipes, a lumpy thud, bolts tinkling across stone
TK-U-SCRAP.def: its mismatched plating clatters and dents: a hollow pot-metal bong, a clumsy shower of loose scrap, a ratcheting snap as a spare part clips back
